name: Context Menu Preferences
description: Bring back the full classic right-click menu on Windows 11 and remove the Share entry.
author: AETHER

compatibility.notes: The classic-menu switch uses a widely documented per-user COM override that Microsoft may change in future builds.

settings.label: Always show the classic context menu

documentation.whatItChanges: Creates an empty InprocServer32 default value under HKCU\Software\Classes\CLSID\{86ca1aa0-…} and/or blocks the ModernSharing shell extension for your user.
documentation.uninstall: The keys are removed and Explorer restarts.
